package org.eclipse.rdf4j.sail.lmdb;

import java.nio.file.Path;

import org.eclipse.rdf4j.common.transaction.IsolationLevels;
import org.eclipse.rdf4j.model.impl.SimpleValueFactory;
import org.eclipse.rdf4j.sail.lmdb.config.LmdbStoreConfig;

/** Creates a genuine v6 seed through the frozen original optimized writer, using public configuration only. */
public final class LmdbTinyMapFixtureProducer {

	private LmdbTinyMapFixtureProducer() {
	}

	public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
		Path directory = Path.of(args[0]);
		boolean inline = Boolean.parseBoolean(args[1]);
		var config = new LmdbStoreConfig("spoc,posc,ospc")
				.setTripleTermIndexes("spoc,cspo").setTripleDBSize(64L * 1024)
				.setValueDBSize(8L * 1024 * 1024).setInlineLiterals(inline)
				.setSketchEstimatorEnabled(false).setNativeEvaluationEnabled(false)
				.setDirectAdjacencyEnabled(false).setValueOverlayEnabled(false).setForceSync(true);
		LmdbStore store = new LmdbStore(directory.toFile(), config);
		store.init();
		try (var connection = store.getConnection()) {
			var values = SimpleValueFactory.getInstance();
			var subject = values.createIRI("urn:lifetime:seed:subject");
			var predicate = values.createIRI("urn:lifetime:seed:predicate");
			var context = values.createIRI("urn:lifetime:seed:context");
			var inner = values.createTripleTerm(values.createIRI("urn:lifetime:seed:inner"), predicate,
					values.createLiteral("language value", "en"));
			var nested = values.createTripleTerm(subject, predicate, inner);
			connection.begin(IsolationLevels.NONE);
			connection.addStatement(subject, predicate, values.createIRI("urn:lifetime:seed:object"), context);
			connection.addStatement(subject, predicate, values.createLiteral("dictionary seed"), context);
			connection.addStatement(subject, predicate, nested, context);
			connection.commit();
		} finally {
			store.shutDown();
		}
		System.out.println("FROZEN-OPTIMIZE-V6-TINY-MAP-SEED-GREEN inline=" + inline + " statements=3");
	}
}
